method: The exact simulated card is matched by expansion and collector number. All English TCGplayer products with an equivalent normalized name and identical gameplay metadata are compared across sets, rarities, promos, and finishes; jumbo cards and non-playable World Championship Deck reproductions are excluded. The highest positive market price is used; low price is used only when no market price exists for any equivalent product. Shipping, tax, condition, and regional prices are excluded.
